whatToExpect.title: Here's What We Can Do Together 💕

languageLessons.title: Language Lessons
languageLessons.description: One-on-one lessons in Ukrainian, Russian, or English — shaped around you, your pace, and your goals. I've delivered 3,500+ lessons across 30+ countries. Whether you're a total beginner, heritage speaker, or advanced learner — there's a lesson here for you.

translation.title: Translation Services
translation.description: I take poetry seriously — which means I won't just translate the words. I'll carry the feeling, the rhythm, and the soul of what you wrote.

creativeWriting.title: Creative Writing
creativeWriting.description: Captions, articles, brand stories, poems — if it involves words, I'm genuinely in. Let's make your content feel alive.

consulting.title: Consulting
consulting.description: Building a language learning app, ed-tech platform, or content product? I bring 4 years of teaching experience and 3,500+ student interactions to the table. I can advise on curriculum design, user experience, content strategy, and what actually works for language learners.
